svg.aria-label: High level architecture of hr-attrition-power-bi. Sources: Excel workbook (sheet WA_Fn-UseC_-HR-Employee-Attriti). Data warehouse on Power BI (.pbix), 5 layers left to right. Bronze Layer: Object Type Steps in employees_staging; Load Excel.Workbook, Navigate to the sheet, Promote headers; Transformations None (as-is). Silver Layer: Object Type Query (not loaded); Transformations Type 35 columns, Drop 3 constant columns, Add AttritionFlag (Yes = 1); Built by employees_staging. Gold Layer: Object Type DAX columns (7); Transformations Age, tenure, income bands, Sort column per band, Risk Flags (6 flags); Lives in fact_employee. Semantic Layer: Object Type Tables (8); Load Power Query import; Transformations Distinct values per dim, Index surrogate keys, 7 key lookups; Data Model 1 fact, 7 dimensions, 7 relationships, M:1. Analytical Layer: Object Type DAX measures (15); Transformations Headcount, leavers, rate, 1.5 x IQR outliers, High-risk employees; Lives in _Measures. Consume: Power BI report, Reporting Layer, pages Home, 1-Overview, 2-Drivers, 3-Trends & Outliers. Consume: SQL check, sql/attrition_by_department.sql, leavers per department.
svg.title: hr-attrition-power-bi high level architecture
